services.name: private events
services.desc: Pickle at the Palms is not only a place for the pickleball community to gather, it’s perfect for private and professional events too. Let us help you add some fun and healthy competition to your networking mixer, off-site or team building event, your 50th birthday celebration, your kiddo’s 5th grade graduation party and everything in between. Events can be as intimate as 5 people or as large as 500! No matter the size, we can help you create great memories for your entire crew. Beyond pickleball court rentals, The Palms can provide pickleball coaches, organized play sessions, gathering spaces and full catering services offered by our on-site cafe, Mainstay Provisions at The Palms. services.name: Group pickleball
services.desc: Learning to play pickleball is fun, social and gets you up and moving. Everyone can play: from current couch surfers to long-time athletes. All that is required is a desire to learn. Our four-week Beginner Series is a small group lesson series taught by coaches who are hand-picked to teach pickleball in a warm and supportive environment. They are friendly and fun too! Classes are held at a variety of times of the day and days of the week to accommodate all kinds of schedules. Perhaps you’ve played a little bit with friends, but you aren’t sure about the details.
